name: QuoVadis
summary: Quovadis is a turn-based isometric sci-fi war strategy game. Far in the future, humanity has spread across the galaxy, and following a long period of war, peace finally came after a treaty between the 10 great powers of the galaxy. It has been 99 years since then, and peace has prospered. On the 100th anniversary of the treaty, a new peacekeeping fleet not controlled by any one power is being established to strengthen galactic peace. But some of the nations are planning a rebellion, and the students joining this new fleet are about to be swept up in something much greater than they could have ever imagined.
